content: In order to overcome these difficulties of discourse relation parsing in social media, we simplify and minimize the use of syntactic parsing results and capture relations between discourse arguments, and investigate the use of a recursive neural network model (RNN). Recent work has shown that RNNs are effective for utilizing discourse structures for their downstream tasks BIBREF3 , BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , but they have yet to be directly used for discourse relation prediction in social media. We evaluated our model by comparing it to off-the-shelf end-to-end discourse relation parsers and traditional models. We found that the SVM and random forest classifiers work better than the LSTM classifier for the causality detection, while the LSTM classifier outperforms other models for identifying causal explanation.
